name: @stxt-lang/editor
description: The STXT editor for any web page: highlighting, live errors, grammar-driven completion and hover, on CodeMirror 6.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types && npm run build:css
scripts.build:esm: esbuild src/index.ts src/highlight.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2021 --banner:js="/*! @stxt-lang/editor | MIT License | https://stxt.dev */" --external:@codemirror/* --external:@stxt-lang/core --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs
scripts.build:bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=StxtEditor --target=es2021 --minify --banner:js="/*! @stxt-lang/editor | MIT License | https://stxt.dev | Includes CodeMirror 6 (MIT) */" --outfile=dist/stxt-editor.js && esbuild src/highlight.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=StxtHighlight --target=es2021 --minify --banner:js="/*! @stxt-lang/editor | MIT License | https://stxt.dev */" --outfile=dist/stxt-highlight.js
scripts.prebuild: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

author: Joan Costa Mombiela <joan.costa.mombiela@gmail.com>
